content.text: In regions where traditional [[LINK:https://[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/coremerch-sovereign-stack-deployment-guide-honest-side-side-6|COREMERCH guide to coremerch]].github.io/store/blog/payment-options-ethiopian-digital-creators-which-architecture-actually|Payment Options]] platforms like Stripe and PayPal are either unavailable or severely restricted, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-stores-kyc-payments-what-actually-how-4|digital]] creators face significant barriers to establishing their online stores. This guide presents a clear pathway to deploy a fully functional digital store using Cloudflare Pages, leveraging the COREMERCH infrastructure. With this setup, you can accept crypto payments seamlessly and maintain control over your products. Let’s dive into the steps necessary for a successful deployment.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The failure of conventional payment platforms in many regions has left creators without viable options for monetizing their digital products. COREMERCH addresses this challenge by providing sovereign digital commerce stacks that empower creators to own their infrastructure completely. Unlike traditional systems that enforce restrictions, this architecture allows you to operate on your own terms, utilizing blockchain technology for payment processing. This not only bypasses the limitations of conventional payment systems but also ensures that you retain full control and ownership over your data and transactions.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before initiating your deployment on Cloudflare Pages, gather the necessary resources. Ensure you have a Cloudflare account and familiarize yourself with the platform’s interface. You’ll also need to set up a Google account to use Google Apps Script for backend logic. Additionally, prepare your digital products and a NOWPayments account for crypto payment processing. By having these components ready, you can streamline the setup process and minimize downtime during deployment.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start with deploying your backend using Google Apps Script to handle order storage and payment verification. Create a simple script to log orders and monitor payment confirmations via NOWPayments. Once your script is tested, integrate it with your Cloudflare Pages front end to ensure seamless product delivery. Utilizing a combination of Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery, you can effectively manage your digital assets while ensuring instant access for customers upon successful payment verification.
Own your infrastructure completely, without dependence on any platform.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

After completing your setup, it’s time to go live. Publish your Cloudflare Pages site, ensuring that all links and product information are accurate. Conduct a test transaction using NOWPayments to confirm that your payment processing is functioning correctly. This step is critical in validating the entire system from product selection to payment confirmation. Once you’ve processed your first transaction successfully, you can confidently promote your store and begin reaching out to customers.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your digital store is operational, focus on scaling your offerings. Introduce additional products to your inventory and consider upgrading to the Edge Commerce Stack for enhanced capabilities, including support for up to five products and advanced configurations like SPF/DKIM/DMARC. Regularly monitor your sales and customer interactions to optimize your setup further. As your business grows, ensure that your infrastructure scales alongside it, maintaining efficiency and reliability in the customer experience.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

The setup sequence matters because each component depends on the previous one being correctly configured. Start with NOWPayments: create your account, configure wallet addresses for each coin you want to accept, generate the API key, and note the IPN secret key you will set. Then configure the backend: in Stack 01, deploy the Google Apps Script Web App and note its URL; in Stack 02, deploy the Cloudflare Worker and note its URL. Set that URL as the webhook endpoint in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Then configure the storefront. Then run a real mainnet test — send actual crypto to your configured wallet address, confirm NOWPayments detects it, confirm the webhook fires, and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link.
Leverage blockchain technology for secure and instant payment processing.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Creators at the store setup stage comparing Stack 01 and Stack 02 are typically choosing between building it themselves with the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 — which covers both stacks in complete detail with full source code — or having COREMERCH deploy the complete Edge Stack under their accounts with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Both result in the same ownership structure: your GitHub or Cloudflare account, your Supabase database, your NOWPayments account, your wallet, your store. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Create a Cloudflare account and set up Cloudflare Pages. Prepare your digital products for upload. Set up a Google account for Google Apps Script. Write a script for order processing and payment verification using NOWPayments. Test the backend to ensure reliable order tracking. Publish your Cloudflare Pages site and verify all links. Promote your newly established digital store to your audience.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

You can build a digital store for free by using Cloudflare Pages and integrating NOWPayments for crypto transactions. This setup allows you to create a fully functional online store without the need for traditional payment platforms.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 is deployed using GitHub Pages and Apps Script, taking 4-6 hours. Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages and Workers with Supabase, deployed in 48 hours, and includes additional features like enhanced security configurations.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, you can host a digital product store on both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages. Each platform provides the necessary infrastructure for hosting your products and managing transactions effectively.
What are the benefits of using NOWPayments?

NOWPayments offers over 300 cryptocurrencies for payment processing with a low fee of 0.5%. It requires no KYC and allows for instant payment confirmations, ensuring a smooth transaction experience for your customers.
How long does deployment take with COREMERCH?
Deployment with COREMERCH varies by stack. Stack 01 takes approximately 4-6 hours, while Stack 02, which includes more advanced features, is completed in 48 hours, fully tested before handoff.
